title.narrative: Spinning Forward: Enhancing worker rights and conditions in Indian mills.

description.narrative: In the FBK project: Spinning Forward: Enhancing worker rights and conditions in Indian mills, Zeeman cooperates with two of their local suppliers and local actor Paradigm Shift Foundation in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. Together, they will conduct a participatory assessment and co-create a remediation plan for social sustainability risks occurring at deeper levels of the garment industry supply chain. Zeeman has a vision to lead the industry in basic clothing, while proving that sustainably and fairly produced products are affordable for average consumers, and they are working purposefully to prioritize CSR actions. Social risks are more common at the deeper tiers, where companies have less insight and oversight. Therefore, Zeeman is taking action and will focus on improving working conditions within the Tier 3 spinning mills,used by their Tier 1 suppliers. Though each mill has unique circumstances and distinct needs, emerging patterns include increasing numbers of migrant workers, deceptive recruitment strategies, minimal freedom to associate, abuse of contract labor deals, and gender related discrimination. By thoroughly investigating the types and causes of these labor risks at 15 mills, the project aims to “Spin Forward” the status quo in spinning mills, enhancing worker rights and conditions. Spinning Forward will directly benefit the mill employees and set a standard for future sourcing by Zeeman. The envisioned impact centers on collaborative problem solving on social sustainability issues, involving workers, unions, NGOs, and other stakeholders to evaluate and address identified violations. Informed by a Local Impact Assessment, the partners will develop an action plan to tackle the identified risks at each mill, to make practical and sustainable changes. The project is expected to directly benefit workers across the 15 spinning mills and in the end, build a stronger relationship between the mills, suppliers, and Zeeman, to increase stability and transparency leading to better practices and working conditions in Tier 3.
